page: Microsoft Azure M64ds_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv2 family. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core.

This server type includes 2097 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. It does not include integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is designed to support memory-intensive workloads that require substantial local scratch space and high-speed storage access.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M64ds_v2 offers a high density of RAM and dedicated compute resources, making it suitable for large-scale enterprise applications without the overhead of multi-node clustering. The hardware configuration is optimized for large relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data-processing workloads that demand extensive memory capacity and fast local storage.
